text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
December ◆ | Noon | Wind: Pleasant 
Favorable Breeze "With New Crew Aboard" 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Still no word from the patron. However, a 
crowd of new fans has gathered right 
outside our base!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
That's when I learned about crowdfunding, 
where you gather funds from supporters. It 
seems like a winning strategy to our 
Navigator, too.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Making membership cards, issuing 
newsletters, and taking bromides. As a 
result of working frantically, she gained 
500 supporters to back her up!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
With this much support, I can do anything! 
This time for sure, I can aim for the 
castle! I'm gonna carve out the future 
together with these guys!
